web_add_it_to_your_home.message: Add it to your Home Screen so it opens like an app. Do this before you enter your keys: the installed app keeps its own settings, separate from the browser.

web_in_safari_tap_the_share.message: In Safari, tap the Share button ⬆︎ (bottom bar, or top right on iPad; on iOS 26 it may be behind the ••• button).

web_scroll_down_and_tap_add.message: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.

web_leave_open_as_web_app.message: Leave Open as Web App on, if you see it, and tap Add.

web_using_brave_on_iphone_it.message: Using Brave on iPhone? It can't add web apps. <button type="button" id="btnCopyAppLink" class="linkbtn">Copy this page's link</button>, open it in Safari, and follow the steps there. Chrome on iPhone works too: Share → Add to Home Screen.

web_install_it_so_it_opens.message: Install it so it opens like an app, from your home screen or app list.

web_add_it_to_your_home_2.message: Add it to your home screen so it opens like an app: open the browser menu ⋮ and tap Install app or Add to Home screen.

web_on_your_phone_scan_this.message: On your phone: scan this with the phone's camera, then install it from there (the steps appear on the phone).

web_installQr_arialabel.message: QR code with the address of this app

web_or_open_on_your_phone.message: Or open on your phone.

web_installDesktopHint.message: On this computer, your browser's install button (in the address bar or menu) adds it as an app.

web_add_a_manga_page_or.message: Add a manga page or screenshot

web_take_a_screenshot_in_any.message: Take a screenshot in any app or reader, then paste it here — or pick it from Photos. Your images go only to the Claude API with your own key.

web_tip_on_iphone_tap_the.message: Tip: on iPhone, tap the screenshot preview → Share → Copy, then come back and tap Paste.

web_browsers_don_t_let_a.message: Browsers don't let a web page read other websites. So chapter links go through a small program called a fetcher, running on a free Cloudflare account. It opens the chapter and passes the pages to this app. Screenshot mode works without it.

web_someone_who_already_has_a.message: Someone who already has a fetcher can send you one. Paste it here.

web_or_set_up_your_own.message: Or set up your own fetcher

web_free_about_10_minutes_once.message: Free. About 10 minutes, once. Easiest on a computer; afterwards you connect your phone with a link. Tap a grey value to copy it.

web_you_need_both_skip_any.message: You need both. Skip any you already have.

web_github_where_your_copy_of.message: GitHub (where your copy of the fetcher lives): github.com/signup ↗

web_cloudflare_where_it_runs_dash.message: Cloudflare (where it runs): dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up ↗. Confirm your email.

web_only_someone_with_this_key.message: Only someone with this key can use your fetcher. The app remembers it; you'll paste it into Cloudflare in step 5.

web_copy_the_fetcher_to_your.message: Copy the fetcher to your GitHub

web_you_now_have_your_own.message: You now have your own copy, also named <button type="button" class="chip" data-copy="gytakusub" title="Copy">gytakusub</button>. Cloudflare can only deploy from a repository in your own account, which is why this copy is needed.

web_open_dash_cloudflare_com_then.message: Open dash.cloudflare.com ↗, then Workers & Pages → Create application → GitHub.

web_if_asked_allow_cloudflare_to.message: If asked, allow Cloudflare to see your GitHub repositories. Then select your <button type="button" class="chip" data-copy="gytakusub" title="Copy">gytakusub</button>.

web_project_worker_name_gytakusub_exactl.message: Project / Worker name: . Exactly this, or the build fails.

web_path_fetcher_open_advanced_settings.message: Path: . Open Advanced settings to see it. It's the folder the fetcher is in.

web_deploy_command_npx_wrangler_deploy.message: Deploy command:

web_click_save_and_deploy_and.message: Click Save and Deploy and wait about a minute until it says it's deployed.

web_if_the_build_fails_open.message: If the build fails, open the Worker's Settings → Build, check the same fields (the path is called Root directory there), correct them, and deploy again.

web_on_the_worker_s_page.message: On the Worker's page: Settings → Variables and Secrets → Add.

web_type_secret_variable_name_gyt.message: Type: Secret. Variable name: . Value: your key ().

web_copy_the_worker_s_address.message: Copy the Worker's address from its page. It looks like https://gytakusub.your-name.workers.dev.

web_if_the_app_says_your.message: If the app says your fetcher is out of date: open your copy on GitHub and click Sync fork → Update branch. Cloudflare redeploys by itself within a minute. Then Connect again.

web_if_a_cloudflare_screen_looks.message: If a Cloudflare screen looks different, Cloudflare's own help: deploying from GitHub · adding a secret. Steps last checked against those pages on .

web_free_if_it_runs_out.message: Free: if it runs out, the fetcher stops until the reset. Nothing is charged.

web_only_this_device_the_requests.message: Only this device: the requests this browser or app sent today, counted as they're sent. The free 100,000 a day is for your whole Cloudflare account, and its count is higher: before a new page the browser also asks the fetcher for permission (Cloudflare counts that too, so a page is usually 2 requests), and your other devices and anyone with your connection link add theirs. So there's no meter here: set up the live count below to see the real total against the allowance.

web_from_cloudflare_every_request_to.message: From Cloudflare: every request to every Worker on your account today, the browser's permission checks included. Your browsers and the installed app show the same number.

web_a_few_minutes_behind_cloudflare.message: A few minutes behind: Cloudflare adds requests to its count a few minutes after they happen. The count refreshes every minute while this tab is open, and each refresh is itself one request.

web_cloudflare_s_own_count_dash.message: Cloudflare's own count: dash.cloudflare.com ↗ → Workers & Pages → your Worker → Metrics, or set up the live count below.

web_optional_about_3_minutes_easiest.message: Optional, about 3 minutes, easiest on a computer. The fetcher then reads today's count from Cloudflare with a token that can only read analytics.

web_in_dash_cloudflare_com_open.message: In dash.cloudflare.com ↗ open Account API tokens (press Ctrl K, or ⌘ K on a Mac, and search for it). Click Create Token, then under Custom token click Get started.

web_token_name_gytakusub_usage_permissio.message: Token name: . Permissions: Account · Account Analytics · Read, nothing else. Click Continue to summary, then Create Token, and copy the token: Cloudflare shows it only once.

web_press_ctrl_k_again_and.message: Press Ctrl K again and choose Copy account ID.

web_on_your_worker_settings_variables.message: On your Worker: Settings → Variables and Secrets → Add, type Secret, name , value the token. Add one more Secret: , value the account ID. Click Deploy.

web_cloudflare_s_guides_analytics_token.message: Cloudflare's guides: analytics token ↗ · account ID ↗

web_your_fetcher_is_too_old.message: Your fetcher is too old for this. On GitHub open your gytakusub copy, click Sync fork → Update branch. Cloudflare redeploys it in about a minute.

web_copy_this_link_and_open.message: Copy this link and open it on your phone or another computer, or paste it into the Chapter link tab there. Give it only to people you trust with your fetcher: it contains your key.

web_from_platform_claude_com_settings.message: From platform.claude.com → Settings → API keys. Stored only on this device.

web_counted_from_claude_s_own.message: Counted from Claude's own answers to this browser. The extension and your other devices keep their own counts.

web_right_to_left_two_page.message: Right-to-left two-page spreads on wide screens

web_btnShowInstall.message: Install on your phone or computer

web_free_software_under_the_gnu.message: Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 · source code · third-party components

web_fx_challenge.message: This site puts a “checking your browser” wall in front of servers, so the fetcher can't open it. Use screenshot mode here, or the browser extension on a computer.

web_fx_blocked.message: This site refuses the fetcher (it may need a login, or it blocks servers). Use screenshot mode here, or the browser extension on a computer.

web_fx_no_images.message: No chapter pages were found on that page. If the site needs a login or builds its pages with a script, use screenshot mode.

web_fx_not_found.message: The site says that page does not exist. Check the link.

web_fx_unauthorized.message: Your fetcher refused the access key: the key here is not the GYT_KEY on your Worker.

web_fx_setup.message: Your fetcher has no key yet (or one shorter than 24 characters). Do step 5: in Cloudflare open the Worker → Settings → Variables and Secrets, add the Secret GYT_KEY with your key, Deploy, then Connect again.

web_fx_bad_url.message: That doesn't look like a web address of a chapter.

web_fx_usage_old.message: Update your fetcher to {version} or newer for Cloudflare's count.

web_fx_limit.message: Your fetcher has used today's {limit} free requests on Cloudflare. It works again at {time}, and nothing is charged. Screenshot mode still works.

web_fx_silent.message: No answer from your fetcher. Check that you're online. Otherwise, either today's {limit} free requests are used up (it works again at {time}, and nothing is charged), or this page needed more work than Cloudflare's free plan allows per request (10 ms). Screenshot mode still works.

web_fx_no_answer.message: No answer from {address}. Check the address (copy it from the Worker's page in Cloudflare) and that the deploy finished.

web_fx_cpu.message: This page needed more work than Cloudflare's free plan allows per request (10 ms). Try again; if it keeps failing, use screenshot mode for this chapter.

web_fx_not_fetcher_http.message: {address} answered HTTP {status}, not like a Gytakusub fetcher. Check the address.

web_fx_short_key.message: The access key must be at least {n} characters (generate one in step 2).

web_fx_not_fetcher.message: {address} answered, but not like a Gytakusub fetcher.

web_fx_outdated.message: Your fetcher is version {version}; this app needs {needed} or newer. On GitHub, open your gytakusub copy → Sync fork → Update branch; wait a minute, then Connect again.

web_no_key.message: No API key set — open Settings (⚙) and paste your Claude API key.

web_usage_note_live.message: All your devices · starts again at {time}

web_usage_note_device_one.message: {n} chapter opened · the allowance starts again at {time}

web_usage_note_device_other.message: {n} chapters opened · the allowance starts again at {time}

web_live_not_yet.message: Not yet: the Worker has no CF_API_TOKEN and CF_ACCOUNT_ID secrets (after adding them, click Deploy).

web_live_on.message: Live count from Cloudflare is on.

web_saved_personal.message: Saved for your personal reading. Please don't redistribute translated pages.

web_paste_how.message: Paste with Ctrl/⌘+V, or long-press the page and choose Paste.

web_clipboard_empty.message: Clipboard has no image. Copy a screenshot first.

web_clipboard_denied.message: Clipboard access was denied. Use Choose photos instead.

web_chapter_pages_one.message: {n} page. Scroll — pages translate as they come into view.

web_chapter_pages_other.message: {n} pages. Scroll — pages translate as they come into view.

web_key_first.message: Generate a key in step 2 first

web_connected_toast.message: Fetcher connected. Paste a chapter link.

web_not_a_link.message: That isn't a connection link. It looks like https://gywreb.github.io/gytakusub/#connect=…

web_confirm_forget.message: Remove the fetcher address and key from this device? Chapter links stop working here until you connect again.

web_installed.message: Installed. Open Gytakusub from your home screen or app list.

web_link_filled.message: A connection link filled in the fetcher at {address}. If you trust it, tap Connect.

web_tap_load.message: Tap Load to open this chapter.

web_setup_waiting.message: Set up chapter links below; this chapter will be waiting.

web_labels_english.message: Buttons on GitHub and Cloudflare are named here in English, as those sites show them in English.
